# AIsec rule catalog

<!-- Generated from rules/catalog.json by scripts/rule-catalog.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Public catalog of deterministic rules shipped with AIsec. Evidence levels describe the default static signal, while applicability and review fields document bounded coverage rather than exploitability or certification.

Catalog version `1.0.0`: 59 shipped deterministic rules (56 native, 3 bundled Opengrep).

A version range of `*` is not a full-framework support claim. It means AIsec does not gate that rule on dependency semver; only the bounded syntax, configuration, artifact format or bundled engine rule described by the applicability profile is covered.

| Rule | Source | Default evidence | CWE | Applicability | Summary | Known false-positive modes | Review guidance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `supabase.table-without-rls` | native | `static_confirmed` | `CWE-862` | Supabase/PostgreSQL RLS migrations * (configuration) | Supabase application table is created without enabling RLS | RLS may be enabled by an unscanned migration, provisioning step or generated schema outside the repository. | Inspect the deployed database catalog and migration order, then require explicit least-privilege policies for every client-accessible operation. |
| `supabase.permissive-rls-policy` | native | `static_confirmed` | `CWE-863` | Supabase/PostgreSQL RLS migrations * (configuration) | Supabase RLS policy unconditionally allows access | The policy may target an intentionally public table, a narrow role or only one deliberately public operation. | Review target roles and commands in the deployed policy and bind private rows to auth.uid(), tenant membership or another trusted claim. |
| `supabase.authenticated-policy-without-row-filter` | native | `static_confirmed` | `CWE-862` | Supabase/PostgreSQL RLS migrations * (configuration) | Supabase permissive policy authenticates callers without filtering rows | The table or command may intentionally be global to every authenticated user, or an unscanned database role/grant boundary may prevent client access. | Inspect every permissive policy for the same role and command because they compose with OR; bind private rows to auth.uid(), a protected membership table or trusted app_metadata tenant claim. |
| `supabase.user-metadata-authorization` | native | `static_confirmed` | `CWE-863` | Supabase/PostgreSQL RLS migrations * (configuration) | Supabase policy trusts user-editable JWT metadata for authorization | A custom token-issuance boundary may make the similarly named claim immutable, or the scanned policy may not be deployed. | Confirm the exact JWT claim source; move roles and tenant membership to server-controlled app_metadata or protected tables, then bind the trusted claim to each row. |
| `firebase.unconditional-access` | native | `static_confirmed` | `CWE-862` | Cloud Firestore/Storage Security Rules * (configuration) | Firebase security rule grants unconditional access | The matched path may intentionally contain public data or the scanned rule file may not be the deployed ruleset. | Confirm the deployed rules and data sensitivity, then require request.auth plus ownership/tenant checks for non-public operations. |
| `firebase.authenticated-access-without-resource-check` | native | `static_confirmed` | `CWE-862` | Cloud Firestore/Storage Security Rules * (configuration) | Firebase rule authenticates callers without authorizing the resource | The matched documents or files may intentionally be shared with every authenticated user, or a different deployed ruleset may be active. | Review overlapping matches because any true allow grants access; compare request.auth.uid or a trusted custom claim with path, owner, tenant, resource or protected membership data. |
| `firebase.storage-upload-without-size-limit` | native | `static_confirmed` | `CWE-770` | Cloud Firestore/Storage Security Rules * (configuration) | Firebase Storage upload rule has no visible file-size ceiling | A trusted server-only client, platform quota or external upload gateway may impose a smaller effective limit, or the path may intentionally accept large files. | Confirm the deployed Storage rules and upload path, add a request.resource.size upper bound, and validate contentType/metadata when the application expects a constrained format. |

## Boundary

This catalog documents shipped deterministic checks and their intended review context. It does not establish exploitability, complete framework coverage, a tested-semver guarantee or security certification. External Gitleaks and Trivy rule IDs are upstream runtime data and are not enumerated here.
